title: Zesty Yeasty Polish Mushroom Casserole
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring sautéed mushrooms and a light, yeasty crust, made with vegetable oil and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, served en-croute.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, sauté the mushrooms and onion in vegetable oil until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the yeast, flour, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spoon the mushroom mixture onto one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the casserole in a baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
